title: Puzzle 3D UI Freeze Incremental Precompute And Worker Backed Plugins
description: Fix multi-minute UI freezes in puzzle-3d when loading an example or clicking "suggest objects". Root cause part A: Puzzle3dPlayApp::handle_action calls sync_precompute_session -> set_scene unconditionally every action, and set_scene always rebuild_queue()s (wipes brush_cache + FillBuilder + re-enqueues 1000 FillSteps), then drive_precompute grinds 128x32=4096 Monte-Carlo collision task units synchronously; the 120ms suggestionsTick/fillBuildTick loops restart this from zero every tick so it never converges. Fix: make set_scene idempotent (skip rebuild when scene JSON unchanged), invalidate cache on real register_mesh, bound drive_precompute to a single precompute_step(8) per tick, apply same guard to puzzle 5d's drive path. Root cause part B: the React host (framework/core/js/index.ts loadPluginModuleUncached) loads plugin WASM and calls handleAction synchronously on the main thread; port the existing wgpu PluginWorkerClient pattern (framework/renderer/wgpu/js/boot.ts) so plugins run in a Web Worker instead, with no timeout-kill (only a logging watchdog) since long actions must not destroy plugin state.
summary:
Found and fixed the real root cause of "no immediate 3D preview when hovering suggested objects" — confirmed live in the browser, not just via code inspection this time.

**Root cause (systemic serde bug):** `HostEffect` (framework/core/rs/lib.rs) was annotated `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`. On a Rust enum, `rename_all` only renames the *variant tags* (e.g. "SetActiveTool" -> "setActiveTool") — it does NOT cascade into the fields *inside* each struct-like variant (serde has a distinct `rename_all_fields` attribute, stable since 1.0.126, for that). So `SetActiveTool { window_kind_id, tool_id }` was shipping literal `window_kind_id`/`tool_id` keys over the wire, while `framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx`'s `applyHostEffects` destructures `const { windowKindId, toolId } = effect.setActiveTool` — both came back `undefined`. The guard `if (windowKindId === activeWindowIdRef.current)` then always failed, so the view state's `activeToolId` never actually flipped to `"brush"` after `openVortexSuggestions` requested it. `world_brush_preview_json`'s gate (`if envelope.active_tool != "brush" { return None }`) stayed shut forever, so `brushPreviewJson` was always null and `BrushPreviewGhost` never rendered anything — no 3D preview, ever, regardless of hover.

Diagnosed by dispatching real actions directly through the app's own `onAction` (found via the React fiber tree from a canvas DOM node) and monkey-patching the plugin handle's `handleAction` to capture the raw wire response — this is what actually exposed the snake_case field names, which no amount of static code reading had surfaced.

**Fix:** added `rename_all_fields = "camelCase"` alongside the existing `rename_all = "camelCase"` on the `HostEffect` enum. This also fixes the identical latent bug in every other multi-word-field variant (`SetPanel.panel_json`, `DownloadMediaExport.mime_type`, `RequestFileOpen.read_as`/`import_action`, `SpawnPluginInstance.program_id`/`os_instance_id`/`document_json`, `OpenPluginInstance.program_id`/`os_instance_id`), not just `SetActiveTool`.

Rebuilt the puzzle plugin WASM (`SEMIO_PLUGIN=puzzle bun ./script.ts plugin` in framework/product/os/dev) and verified end-to-end live in the browser: `activeTool` correctly becomes `"brush"` after opening suggestions, `brushPreviewJson` populates with real candidate data, and a translucent highlighted preview mesh now renders at the target vortex and visibly updates (position/orientation) as different rows are hovered — screenshots confirmed both the list-row highlight and the live 3D preview working together.

Also carried forward from the prior pass: the `menuListItemClassName` + `data-selected` hover-styling fix on `WorldSuggestionMenu`'s rows (framework/renderer/react/components/world-3d-host.tsx) — now confirmed working live too (row highlight visibly follows both hover and the server-confirmed active candidate).

Tests: `puzzle-plugin` 54/54, `puzzle_5d` 2/2, `semio-framework-core` 37/37 — all green after the fix.
